findings.note: Apply path calls nodeDiff for every unapplied kind, including kinds that do not implement DiffDecoder: one extra git.Diff per node and a new git-error failure mode at apply time where decode previously needed no diff. Documented tradeoff in the code comment; decodeKind falls back to plain Decode so behavior for non-diff kinds is unchanged on success. No correctness issue; efficiency/resilience residual accepted.

The apply-time diff is recomputed against the current session head rather than persisted with the node output; if head advanced between the instruction build and apply, the anchor gate would judge against a different diff than the lenses reviewed. In this FSM the apply follows in the same advance pass, so the window is not reachable; residual structural risk accepted and noted for the record.

Hand-rolled atoi initially reads as an integer-wrap risk, but the saturation guard (n > (2^31-11)/10) caps the maximum reachable value at 2147483639 < 2^31-1, no inverted range is possible, and a saturation test pins it. No defect.
